steps.text: Player 1 passes to Player 2 on the side and moves into the middle.
Player 2 passes down to Player 3 and heads for the net.
Player 3 finds Player 1 in the middle, then moves up along the board.
Player 1 lays the ball back into the path of Player 3.
Player 3 decides: shoot, pass to Player 2 at the far post, or play the high slot. Here: the direct shot, Player 2 waits for the rebound.
